QuestInfo.name: A Leatherworker in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It seems the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# is finally ready to acknowledge my leatherworking skills.
QuestInfo.1: Impressed by my growth, the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# suggested that I showcase what I'm capable of. I need to defeat #r#o22#s#k and craft #b1 #t3010005##k, then bring it back.
QuestInfo.2: Amazed by my craftsmanship, the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# handed me a #t4130002#. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter equipment stats. Should I try using it?

0.0: Rumors that you've become a proper leatherworker have reached even the back alleys of #m10003000#. Got me curious whether they're actually true. From the looks of it, you've built up some skill and experience... but are you really better than me? Let's see what you've got.

yes.0: Tch, pretty confident, aren't you? Fine. Then go take down #r#o22#s#k near #m10004000# and bring me #b1 #t3010005##k. I'll be waiting. Heh...

no.0: Looks like you haven't reached that level yet. And you expect me to call you my partner like this?

1.0: Let's take a look... Huh. This isn't bad at all. Tch--fine, I'll admit it. This is solid work. I'm honestly surprised you've built up this much skill. Yeah, this is good enough to call you a real leatherworker. All right, you've earned my respect. Guess I should give you something special...

yes.0: This #t4130002# is a special item that can be used during crafting to change the stats of equipment . It's pretty unstable, so sometimes the results can be disappointing--but if you handle it right, you might end up with something beyond your expectations.
yes.1: If you really want to test the limits of your leatherworking skills, I'd say give it a try. Heh... and don't get lazy with your training.

mob.0: Looks like you didn't manage to defeat all the monsters I mentioned. Guess it was all talk after all?

item.0: Looks like you don't have what I asked for. Guess it was all talk after all?
